audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[0..6] reads Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank/Skill/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank and the full phases repeat it, but the packet chart is Teemo/Teemo/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank/Gangplank/Gangplank and the prose agrees with the packet: whys[0] and whys[1] both concede the stage, whys[2] says 'roughly even now', whys[3] says 'you take over'.
audit.why: Teemo's blind plus Toxic Shot chip beats a Gangplank with one low-HP keg on a long cooldown; the lane flips once a second keg point lets the barrel sit outside Blinding Dart's 680 range.
audit.corrected: Both charts set to Teemo/Teemo/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank/Gangplank/Gangplank with ratings to match.

audit.why: Spikes name the right windows: Teemo's level 1-3 blind-and-chip, Gangplank's level 4-5 out-of-range keg, the Sheen burst, and the late 1v1 with shroom clearing. Four entries present. The mirror's level 4-5 pricing (Blinding Dart flat 7s against a 14-15s keg recharge) is now carried into phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: TWO factual errors that reverse the advice. First, whys[0], spikes[0].text, early and wants.foe[0] all state that Blinding Dart makes your PARRRLEY miss. Blind stops basic attacks; Parrrley is a spell and lands through it — the mirror audit established exactly this and the full layer already says 'Blinds autos — NOT your barrels', so the two layers currently contradict each other on the same page. Second, wants.you[2] and early tell you to 'cleanse his poison' with Remove Scurvy. Remove Scurvy cures crowd control; it strips the mushroom slow, not the Toxic Shot poison.
audit.why: Riot text, Remove Scurvy (W): 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health' — crowd control only. Blinding Dart (Q) is a flat 7s at every rank, 680 range. Parrrley is a flat 4.5s at 625 range, so it is the one detonator a blind cannot stop; a hand-detonation auto is stopped.
audit.corrected: Every 'blinds your Parrrley' claim re-pointed to autos and hand-detonation; the Remove Scurvy line re-pointed to the mushroom slow and the missing-HP heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the full layer.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank — it never gets shorter, which is unusual and worth stating — against a keg recharge of roughly 14-15s, so he can blind twice per barrel you place.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing records that Toxic Shot is an on-hit effect scaling with attack speed, so a pure-armour read of the trade is wrong.
audit.why: Riot text, Toxic Shot (E): 'Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target On-Hit, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.'

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are Teemo's. Blinding Dart (Q) makes your next Parrrley and autos miss, so he can free-hit your low-HP kegs to deny them and chip you with poison while your barrels sit on long cooldowns — you have no answer to his poke yet. Don't throw a Parrrley he can just blind, and don't place a keg he'll walk up and pop. Last-hit at max Parrrley range, eat a little poison, and cleanse the worst of it with Remove Scurvy (W) when your missing-HP heal is worth it. His chip can't kill through your W sustain — just deny him a snowball.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are Teemo's. Blinding Dart (Q) blinds your autos for its duration, so you cannot hand-detonate a keg — Parrrley is the one popper that still lands, and it is a flat 4.5 seconds. He free-hits your low-HP kegs to deny them and chips you with Toxic Shot poison while your barrels sit on long cooldowns. Last-hit at max Parrrley range and spend Remove Scurvy (W) for the missing-HP heal, not as a cleanse — it strips crowd control, not his poison. His chip can't kill through that sustain; just deny him a snowball.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Blinding Dart's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
